regulation.AFI: Authorized financial institution: the SFO's name for a bank, restricted licence bank or deposit-taking company authorized under the Banking Ordinance.
regulation.AI: Authorized institution: a licensed bank, restricted licence bank or deposit-taking company authorized by the HKMA under the Banking Ordinance.
regulation.AML/CFT: Anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism.
regulation.AMLO: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615). It also licenses virtual asset trading platforms (Part 5B).
regulation.API: Application programming interface: a defined way for one system to call another.
regulation.ASPIRe: The SFC's February 2025 roadmap for virtual assets; the letters stand for its five pillars: Access, Safeguards, Products, Infrastructure and Relationships.
regulation.BCAN: Broker-to-Client Assigned Number: the unique code a broker gives each client under the HKIDR, sent with every order to the stock exchange.
regulation.BCBS: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision: the global standard-setter for bank capital and liquidity.
regulation.BO: Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155): the statute under which the HKMA authorizes and supervises banks.
regulation.BRDR: Banking Regulatory Document Repository: the HKMA's online library of guidelines, SPM modules and circulars.
regulation.CAAP: Capital adequacy assessment process: a bank's own assessment of the capital it needs (also ICAAP).
regulation.CAMEL: The HKMA's bank rating system: capital adequacy, asset quality, management, earnings and liquidity.
regulation.CCASS: Central Clearing and Settlement System: HKEX's system for clearing, settling and holding Hong Kong listed shares.
regulation.CDD: Customer due diligence: identifying and verifying a customer and understanding the relationship.
regulation.CFI: Cybersecurity Fortification Initiative: the HKMA's cyber-resilience programme for banks.
regulation.CI: Critical infrastructure, as in a designated CI operator under the Protection of Critical Infrastructures (Computer Systems) Ordinance (Cap. 653).
regulation.CIS: Collective investment scheme: a fund or similar pooled investment (SFO Sch. 1).
regulation.CMDB: Configuration management database: an inventory of IT assets and how they connect.
regulation.CMU: Central Moneymarkets Unit: the HKMA's settlement and custody system for debt securities.
regulation.CPT: Continuous professional training: the yearly training the SFC expects of licensed and registered individuals.
regulation.CVA: Credit valuation adjustment: the capital charge for a counterparty's credit quality on derivatives.
regulation.CoBP: Code of Banking Practice: the industry code issued by the HKAB and the DTC Association and endorsed by the HKMA.
regulation.DPS: Deposit Protection Scheme: protects eligible deposits up to a set limit if a bank fails (Cap. 581).
regulation.DTC: Deposit-taking company: the lowest of the three tiers of authorized institution.
regulation.DeFi: Decentralised finance: financial services run by smart contracts on a blockchain.
regulation.EO: Executive officer: for a registered institution, an individual approved by the HKMA (BO s.71C) to supervise a regulated activity directly.
regulation.FAQ: Frequently asked questions: regulators publish many of their interpretations this way.
regulation.FDRC: Financial Dispute Resolution Centre: runs the FDRS.
regulation.FDRS: Financial Dispute Resolution Scheme: mediation, then arbitration, of money disputes between customers and banks or SFC-regulated firms.
regulation.FINI: Fast Interface for New Issuance: HKEX's platform for settling Hong Kong IPOs.
regulation.FPS: Faster Payment System: Hong Kong's real-time retail payment system.
regulation.FRR: Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules (Cap. 571N): capital rules for licensed corporations.
regulation.FRTB: Fundamental Review of the Trading Book: the Basel market-risk framework.
regulation.FSTB: Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau: the government policy bureau for financial regulation.
regulation.GMRA: Global Master Repurchase Agreement: the standard contract for repos.
regulation.HKCFA: Court of Final Appeal (in a neutral citation).
regulation.HKCFI: Court of First Instance (in a neutral citation).
regulation.HKEX: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited: owner of the stock exchange (SEHK), the futures exchange and their clearing houses.
regulation.HKIDR: Hong Kong Investor Identification Regime: brokers tag each order on the stock exchange with a client code (BCAN).
regulation.HKMA: Hong Kong Monetary Authority: the central banking institution and banking regulator. In the statutes its powers belong to the Monetary Authority (MA).
regulation.HKSCC: Hong Kong Securities Clearing Company: the HKEX clearing house for the stock market.
regulation.HKeL: Hong Kong e-Legislation: the government's official online database of legislation.
regulation.IA: Insurance Authority: the regulator of insurers and insurance intermediaries (Cap. 41).
regulation.ICF: Investor Compensation Fund: pays investors, up to a cap, if a licensed or registered intermediary defaults on exchange-traded products (SFO Part XII).
regulation.ILAS: Investment-linked assurance scheme: a life policy whose value tracks investment funds.
regulation.ISO: International Organization for Standardization (as in ISO 27001).
regulation.JFIU: Joint Financial Intelligence Unit: run by the Police and Customs; it receives suspicious transaction reports.
regulation.KYC: Know your client (or customer): finding out who the client is, their finances, experience and objectives.
regulation.LAC: Loss-absorbing capacity: debt and capital that can be written down in a resolution (Cap. 628B).
regulation.LC: Licensed corporation: a company licensed by the SFC under SFO s.116 to carry on regulated activities.
regulation.MA: Monetary Authority: the head of the HKMA. The Banking Ordinance and the SFO give the HKMA's powers to the MA.
regulation.MIC: Manager-in-charge: a senior manager the SFC expects a licensed corporation to name for each core function.
regulation.MMT: Market Misconduct Tribunal: hears civil market misconduct cases under SFO Part XIII.
regulation.MPF: Mandatory Provident Fund: Hong Kong's compulsory retirement savings system.
regulation.MPFA: Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Authority: regulates MPF schemes and registers MPF intermediaries.
regulation.MRC: Mandatory Reference Checking scheme: banks share staff conduct records when hiring.
regulation.MSO: Money service operator: a remittance or money-changing business licensed by Customs under AMLO.
regulation.MoU: Memorandum of understanding: a non-statutory agreement between regulators on how they share work.
regulation.NCWO: No creditor worse off: the resolution safeguard that compensates creditors left worse off than in a liquidation.
regulation.OTC: Over the counter: traded directly between two parties rather than on an exchange.
regulation.PI: Professional investor: an institution, or a wealthy individual or company meeting the thresholds in Cap. 571D, who gets less protection.
regulation.PSSVFO: Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584).
regulation.RACI: Responsible, accountable, consulted, informed: a matrix of who does what.
regulation.RI: Registered institution: a bank (authorized institution) registered with the SFC under SFO s.119 to carry on regulated activities.
regulation.RLB: Restricted licence bank: the middle of the three tiers of authorized institution.
regulation.RO: Responsible officer: an individual approved by the SFC (SFO s.126) to supervise a licensed corporation's regulated activity.
regulation.RTO: Recovery time objective: how quickly a system must be restored after an outage.
regulation.SEHK: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, owned by HKEX.
regulation.SFAT: Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal: reviews SFC decisions, and some HKMA decisions on registered institutions.
regulation.SFC: Securities and Futures Commission: Hong Kong's statutory regulator of the securities and futures markets.
regulation.SIM: Subscriber identity module (a phone's SIM card).
regulation.SPM: Supervisory Policy Manual: the HKMA's collection of supervisory modules (such as TM-G-1).
regulation.STR: Suspicious transaction report, filed with the JFIU.
regulation.SVF: Stored value facility: an e-wallet or prepaid card licensed by the HKMA under Cap. 584.
regulation.TCF: Treat Customers Fairly: the HKMA's charter for fair treatment of retail customers.
regulation.VA: Virtual asset: a cryptocurrency or similar digital token, as defined in AMLO s.53ZRA.
regulation.VATP: Virtual asset trading platform: a crypto exchange. Running one in Hong Kong needs an SFC licence.
regulation.WMC: Cross-boundary Wealth Management Connect: lets Greater Bay Area residents buy eligible investment products through banks across the boundary.

mna.APA: Asset purchase agreement: the buyer acquires chosen assets and liabilities, not the company.
mna.CFIUS: Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States: reviews foreign acquisitions for national security.
mna.CUAD: Contract Understanding Atticus Dataset: a public set of labelled commercial-contract clauses.
mna.DD: Due diligence: the buyer's investigation of the target.
mna.HSR: Hart-Scott-Rodino Act: the US pre-merger notification regime.
mna.IRS: Internal Revenue Service: the US tax authority.
mna.LOI: Letter of intent: a mostly non-binding summary of the proposed deal terms.
mna.QoE: Quality of earnings: an accountant's review of how sustainable the target's reported earnings are.
mna.R&W: Representations and warranties: the seller's statements of fact about the target.
mna.SPA: Share (or stock) purchase agreement: the buyer acquires the target company's shares.
